meta.name: hunt-lateral-movement
meta.description: Hunt for lateral movement using PsExec, WMI, or similar techniques. Use when proactively searching for attackers moving through your network using admin tools. Searches for service installations, remote process execution, and suspicious network correlations.

copy.tagline: 搜索网络中横向移动的痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要主动发现攻击者在内网中的横向移动行为。
copy.tagline_en: Search for lateral movement traces in your network
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to proactively detect attackers moving laterally using admin tools.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会主动搜索网络日志中由PsExec或WMI等工具留下的横向移动痕迹，包括服务安装事件、远程进程创建和可疑SMB连接，并分析结果找出异常行为。
howto.when: 当用户要求主动搜索横向移动迹象，或指定使用PsExec、WMI等攻击技术进行威胁猎杀时触发。

say.text: 搜索过去72小时内是否有PsExec横向移动。
say.note: Claude将检索服务安装和进程创建日志。

say.text: 检查设备中WMI远程执行的异常进程。
say.note: 会搜索WmiPrvSE.exe作为父进程的启动。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude proactively searches security logs for lateral movement artifacts left by tools like PsExec or WMI, including service installations, remote process creation, and suspicious SMB connections, then analyzes findings for anomalies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to proactively hunt for lateral movement indicators, or specifies techniques like PsExec or WMI for threat hunting.

say_en.text: Search for PsExec lateral movement in the last 72 hours.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve service installation and process creation logs.

say_en.text: Check for anomalous WMI remote execution processes.
say_en.note: Searches for processes spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe.
